summary: RETEST iteration 17 — daily founder digest. The previously failing dedupe-by-default assertion now passes. server.py:330 confirmed `force: bool = False`. Full test_daily_digest.py suite: 10/10 GREEN. Spec compliance verified: POST /api/founder/digest/send (no params) returns {sent: false, reason: 'already_sent_today'} after today's slot is taken; POST /api/founder/digest/send?force=true bypasses dedupe and re-sends; all regression checks (preview HTML+counts, is_test exclusion, anonymous voice counting, jury 403, auth gating, scheduler startup log) still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Carryover from iter16 (NOT blocking, still worth addressing eventually): (a) daily_digest.send_digest_now persists system_state on force=true sends too, which will block the 07:00 UTC scheduler run for that day; (b) render_html injects user-supplied presale/voice fields into HTML without html.escape() — low risk because email clients sandbox JS, but a `<script>` in a name renders raw; (c) start_scheduler has no idempotency guard against double-invocation on hot reload; (d) _collect uses ISO-string comparison on created_at — safe only as long as all writers continue to write ISO strings.

seed_data_creation: Per-class fixture seeded 2 presale_signups (1 real + 1 is_test) and 3 voice_tryout_leads (1 real with email, 1 anonymous, 1 is_test) prefixed TEST_*_<8hex>. system_state.daily_digest wiped pre + post TestDigestSend. All cleanup ran successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_daily_digest.py is the authoritative regression suite for the founder daily digest. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_daily_digest.py -v. TestDigestSend class wipes system_state.daily_digest in setup/teardown so it is repeatable. If the day rolls over between iterations the test still works because send_force_true_dispatches creates today's slot, then test_send_default_force_false_dedupes asserts the dedupe kicks in.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration_16 root cause (server.py:330 default `force: bool = True`) has been corrected to `force: bool = False`. Confirmed by grep and by behavioural test: after a force=true send sets system_state.last_sent_date=today, a subsequent no-param POST returns sent:false / reason:already_sent_today (was returning sent:true before the fix).
